sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a "Length info - Deviation" section to the "Length" column's unique-values (📊) dropdown: buckets each row by how far its Length deviates from the page's average Length (within 10% / 10-25% / 25-50% / 50%+ shorter or longer). Rows flagged "live" in the page's "Attributes" column (or a per-pageType-configurable equivalent, via a new `features.lengthDeviationLiveColumn` key) are excluded from the average — so extended live versions don't skew what counts as "normal" for studio tracks — while still being bucketed against that studio average. Toggleable via the new `sa_enable_length_deviation_section` setting (default on), since this is the first dropdown section that needs a table-wide average rather than a pure per-cell computation.
